The main takeaway from our work is that
the four-loop gauge beta-function is independent of the representation of the fermions, and that the fermion mass beta-function is independent to three-loop order.
the four-loop gauge beta-function and mass anomalous dimensions for general gauge theories can now be computed in the DRED scheme.
, for a general gauge group, the beta-function coefficients are not simply related to the Casimir invariants of the representation, as is the case at three-loop order.
